host_layer: WSL2 Ubuntu (Hyper-V) on Windows 11 x86-64 host
timing_definition: CLOCK_MONOTONIC elapsed time around the specified ML-KEM operation only; setup (keypair generation for enc/dec) is excluded from timing.
memory_definition: Process maximum resident-set-size high-water mark from getrusage (Linux reports KiB; converted to bytes).
note: x86-64 standardization run. Uses mlkem-native v1.2.0 portable-C backend compiled with GCC under WSL2 Ubuntu on the same AMD physical CPU as the pqcrypto reference run. Allows direct implementation-matched comparison with ARM64 and RISC-V mlkem-native runs.
